Lemma
[Concatenation preserves radial classes] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0032 1. Lemma 4.4\group section-4

If $2(l+s)<r$ and $[\theta _1\cup c]=[\theta _2\cup c]$, then $[\theta _1]=[\theta _2]$.

Proof

Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0032 \sketch If $[\theta _1\cup c]=[\theta _2\cup c]$, then $\theta _1\cup c \sim _{2(l+s)} \theta _2\cup c$. Thus

\[ \theta _1 \sim _{2(l+s)} \theta _1\cup c\cup -c \sim _{2(l+s)} \theta _2\cup c\cup -c \sim _{2(l+s)} \theta _2. \]

By uniqueness of radial representatives, $[\theta _1]=[\theta _2]$.

□

Let $\# (q,a)$ denote the number of distinct inverse images of $q \in B_r(p)$ in $B_a(0)$, $a < r$.
